items.body:
MAINTENANCE
Nov 12, 2026
V.272 KNOWN ISSUES

The Known Issues section focuses on the major issues that have significantly impacted the game and community, and which our team is actively addressing. Please note that while we aim to cover the most impactful issues, this list will not encompass every reported issue. Check back regularly for updates on the status of these issues and information on resolved issues, or any new issues that may have been added.

Here you’ll find a list of known and resolved issues from the v.272 - Maplayer One update:

KNOWN ISSUES:
Genesis Pass:
Currently, there is an issue where the Arcane Force buff is not being applied to the Genesis Pass, so following the next scheduled maintenance, an additional Arcane Force buff effect will be applied.
The Genesis Pass use and effect period will be extended by 1 week.
February 9, 2027 11:59 PM UTC → February 16, 2027 11:59 PM UTC
We have identified issues regarding the Extra Storage Selector Coupon and High Quality Bag Selector Coupon from the Operation Ultima Meso Shop.
The usage of these two items have been temporarily restricted and will be usable again in our next scheduled maintenance.
[Updated 11/12 1:52 AM PST] Bags listed below have been temporarily disabled:
80-Slot Android Bag
80-Slot Medal Bag
40-Slot Trait Bag
40-Slot Symbol Coupon Bag
40-Slot Boss Loot Bag
60-Slot Mineral Bag
60-Slot Herb Bag
60-Slot Production Bag
Trace Restoration missions are currently not working as intended. This issue will be fixed during the next scheduled maintenance.
RESOLVED ISSUES:

November 12, 2026

Sol Erda Fragment drops in Quanah have been adjusted.
Sol Erda Fragments dropped in dungeons have been slightly decreased.
Sol Erda Fragments obtained by defeating monsters in the Proving Field have been slightly increased.
Resolved an issue where certain classes in transformation or riding states were unable to use Quanah World Skills.
Resolved an issue where some characters were unable to log in after using items from their Consumables inventory, such as Symbol Coupons, boss loot, or stat-boosting items.
In rare cases, items in the Consumables inventory may have disappeared. These items will be fully restored for all affected players during the scheduled maintenance on Thursday, November 19.
As previously announced, certain items, including Other Slot Selection Coupons, Premium Bag Selection Coupons, and specific items in the Consumables inventory, will become usable after the scheduled maintenance on Thursday, November 19.
Resolved an issue where players could accept more Quanah-exclusive quests than intended.
Characters with 5 quests in progress will have the quests in slots 3, 4, and 5 removed. Only the quests in slots 1 and 2 will remain.
Resolved an issue where the game client for Phantom characters would disconnect when opening the Skill window.

November 11, 2026

Resolved an issue where Sol Erda Energy obtained from certain sources could not be used by some characters Lv. 290 and above once they had 20 Sol Erda.
Resolved an issue where the Beyond Burning event was not visible in the Event List for some characters.
Resolved an issue where characters designated for Quanah World Leap were unable to World Leap to Quanah after claiming the Maplayer One video rewards.
items.bodyZh:
维护公告
2026年11月12日
V.272 已知问题

已知问题部分主要聚焦于对游戏及社区造成重大影响、且我们团队正在积极处理的主要问题。请注意，尽管我们力求涵盖影响最大的问题，但此列表不会包含所有已报告的问题。请定期回来查看这些问题的最新状态、已解决问题信息，或可能新增的任何新问题。

以下为 v.272 - Maplayer One 更新中的已知问题与已解决问题列表：

已知问题：
我们已确认关于 Operation Ultima 金币商店中额外仓库选择券和高级背包选择券的问题。
这两个物品的使用已暂时受限，将在下次计划维护后恢复可用。
Trace Restoration 任务目前未按预期运作。此问题将在下次计划维护期间修复。
已解决问题：

2026年11月11日

修复了从特定来源获得的 Sol Erda 能量在部分290级及以上角色拥有20个 Sol Erda 后无法使用的问题。
修复了部分角色的活动列表中无法看到 Beyond Burning 活动的问题。
修复了被指定参加 Quanah World Leap 的角色在领取 Maplayer One 视频奖励后无法 World Leap 至 Quanah 的问题。

items.title: maintenanceNov 12, 2026[Completed] Unscheduled Quanah World Channel Maintenance - November 12, 2026The channel maintenance has been completed. Thank you for your patience.

MAINTENANCE
Nov 12, 2026
[COMPLETED] UNSCHEDULED QUANAH WORLD CHANNEL MAINTENANCE - NOVEMBER 12, 2026

[Updated 8:50 PM PDT] The channel maintenance has been completed. Thank you for your patience.

We will be performing an unscheduled channel maintenance for Event World: Quanah today, Thursday, November 12, 2026 at 5:20 PM PST (8:20 PM EST / 2:20 AM CET November 13 / 12:20 PM AEDT November 13). We anticipate the maintenance to last approximately 3 hours, concluding around 8:20 PM PST (11:20 PM EST / 5:20 AM CET November 13/ 3:20 PM AEDT November 13).

Times:

Thursday, November 12, 2026
PST (UTC -8): 5:20 PM - 8:20 PM
EST (UTC -5): 8:20 PM - 11:20 PM
CET (UTC +1):  2:20 AM November 13 - 5:20 AM November 13
AEDT (UTC +11): 12:20 PM November 13 - 3:20 PM November 13

What will be unavailable:

Group A
Channels 1 - 30 on NA Quanah.
Channels 1 - 5 on EU Quanah.
Group B
Channels 31 - 60 on NA Quanah.
Channels 6 - 10 on EU Quanah.

Changes and Updates:

List of all changes and updates will be available on the v.272 Known Issues once the Live Minor Patch has been completed.

items.title: maintenanceNov 9, 2026[Completed] Scheduled Game Update - November 11, 2026The maintenance has been completed and we have extended Cash Shop items in your inventory for 9 hours.
items.body:
MAINTENANCE
Nov 9, 2026
[COMPLETED] SCHEDULED GAME UPDATE - NOVEMBER 11, 2026

[Updated 11/11 at 2:00 PM PST] The maintenance has been completed and we have extended Cash Shop items in your inventory for 9 hours. Please restart your Nexon Launcher or Steam to ensure you receive the latest client update.

We will be performing a scheduled game update starting on Wednesday, November 11, 2026 at 5:00 AM PST (8:00 AM EST / 2:00 PM CET / 12:00 AM AEDT November 12). We anticipate the maintenance to last approximately 9 hours, concluding around 2:00 PM PST (5:00 PM EST / 11:00 PM CET / 9:00 AM AEDT November 12).

Please note that the estimated length of time for each maintenance is subject to change without notification.

Thanks for your patience!

Times:

Wednesday, November 11, 2026
PST (UTC -8): 5:00 AM - 2:00 PM
EST (UTC -5): 8:00 AM - 5:00 PM
CET (UTC +1): 2:00 PM - 11:00 PM
AEDT (UTC +11): 12:00 AM - 9:00 AM November 12

What will be unavailable:

All MapleStory game servers.

Changes and Updates:

MapleStory will be updated to v.272.1.1.
NGS will be updated to 5.3.42.0.
Patch Notes for v.272 HERE!
